kerosene.name: Kerosene
kerosene.rule: A die on the Kerosene space burns its value; a round without one burns 6. Empty tank: you lose.

kerosene-leak.name: Kerosene leak
kerosene-leak.rule: No Kerosene space: each round burns the difference between the engine dice + 1.

intern.name: Intern
intern.rule: A die (not the next token’s number) on your Intern space takes a token; place it like a die. Train all 6 before landing.

wind.name: Wind
wind.rule: After the axis, the wind ring turns by the axis tilt; the wind speed adds to the engines.

real-time.name: Real-time
real-time.rule: 60 seconds per round from the roll; unplaced dice are lost.

ice-brakes.name: Ice brakes
ice-brakes.rule: Pairs of 2, 3, 4, 5 above and below the track, left to right, in one round. Pass the 5 to land.

wind-reversed.name: Wind upside down
wind-reversed.rule: The Wind module is placed the other way round: the airplane starts on the opposite side of the ring, so every wind speed is reversed (headwinds).

altitude-5000.name: Start at 5000 ft
altitude-5000.rule: The game starts at 5000 ft instead of 6000: no starting reroll token and one round fewer.

engines-out.name: Engines out
engines-out.rule: No engines: each player rolls 4 dice but places only 3, and the plane glides one space at the end of every round. Land with the ice brakes past 5 (no speed check).

alarms.name: Alarms
alarms.rule: An Alarm symbol on your approach space flips a random token at the start of a round: its Action takes no dice until the die shown on the token (colour and number, coffee allowed) is placed on it. Alarms never stop a landing.

total-trust.name: Total Trust
total-trust.rule: A round ending on a Total Trust space skips the next strategy talk: the dice roll by themselves.

belly-landing.name: Belly landing
belly-landing.rule: The landing gear is stuck: no dice on it, and you land without it. Only the Flaps, Co-pilot radio and Concentration alarms are used.

adaptation.name: Adaptation
adaptation.rule: Once per game, each player can turn one of their unplayed dice to its opposite face.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.rule: Each round, before placing their 1st die, the First Player may choose to reroll one of their dice.

control.name: Control
control.rule: If you play 2 dice of the same value on the AXIS, immediately gain a Coffee token.

mastery.name: Mastery
mastery.rule: If you play 2 dice with the same value on the ENGINES, immediately gain a Reroll token (only if a token is available).

synchronization.name: Synchronization
synchronization.rule: If you have placed at least one die on Landing Gear, and one die on Flaps, immediately roll the Traffic die. Place it on any empty space on the Control Panel regardless of its colour. Apply the effect of the Traffic die as if it were a normal die. It counts as an extra action for this turn.

working-together.name: Working Together
working-together.rule: Once per round, at any time, a player may place one of their dice onto this Skill. The other player MUST also place one of their dice on this skill (if they have one available). The players swap the values of the 2 dice, then take them back.

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: The base game, step by step, from the rulebook. Each scenario's modules are explained in the scenario picker.

goal.title: Land the plane together
goal.body:
You are the crew of an airliner: the pilot (blue) and the co-pilot (orange). Talk to the Control Tower to clear the traffic, adjust your speed so you don't overshoot the airport, level the plane, deploy the flaps and the landing gear, and brake once you touch down.
You win or lose together.

rounds.title: 7 rounds, 3 phases
rounds.body:
The game is played over 7 rounds, from 6000 ft down to the ground. Each round has 3 phases:
1. Strategy discussion and dice rolls
2. Dice placement
3. End of round

strategy.title: Strategy discussion and dice rolls
strategy.body:
Discuss your strategy at the start of every round, for example "We really need to get rid of that plane" or "Let's make sure we advance 2 spaces". You may not talk about the dice: "If you get a 6, put it here" is not allowed.
Then press "Roll dice": each of you rolls 4 dice that only you can see. From now on, stay completely silent until the end of the round.

reroll.title: Reroll tokens
reroll.body: If the Current Altitude has a Reroll token (the first round at 6000 ft does), it goes to your supply. At any time during the round, either player may spend one: then BOTH players may reroll one or more of their remaining dice, once.

placement.title: Placing dice
placement.body:
Take turns; the arrow on the altitude track shows who plays first (the pilot in the first round). On your turn, place ONE of your dice on a free space of the cockpit.
The pilot places only on blue spaces, the co-pilot only on orange ones; spaces that are both colors take either. Most spaces also take only certain numbers (the first Flaps space takes a 1 or a 2). Radio spaces have a color but any number; Concentration spaces take any die from either player.

mandatory.title: Mandatory: Axis and Engines
mandatory.body:
Every round, each player must place one die on the Axis and one on the Engines. If, at the end of a round, there isn't one die of each color on the Axis and on the Engines, you lose at once.
These spaces are mandatory, but they don't have to be the first ones you fill.

axis.title: Axis
axis.body:
As soon as the second die is placed, compare both dice. Same number: nothing moves. Otherwise, the plane turns as many marks as the difference, toward the player who played the higher die, and stays there: the axis is not reset at the end of the round.
Example: the pilot plays a 5 and the co-pilot a 3: the axis turns 2 marks toward the pilot.
If the axis reaches or passes the last mark, the plane goes into a spin and you lose. At the end of the last round, the plane must be level.

engines.title: Engines
engines.body:
As soon as the second die is placed, add both Engine dice: this is your speed.
Less than the blue Aerodynamics marker: the plane does not advance.
Between the two markers: the approach track advances 1 space.
More than the orange marker: it advances 2 spaces.

collision.title: Collision and overshoot
collision.body:
Planes moving into your Current Position are fine. But if there are still planes in your Current Position when the approach track has to advance, you collide and lose.
If the airport is in your Current Position and the track has to advance, you overshoot the airport and lose.

radio.title: Radio
radio.body:
The pilot has 1 Radio space, the co-pilot 2. Count spaces on the approach track starting with your Current Position, and remove one plane from the space the die reaches at once: a 1 removes a plane from the Current Position, a 2 from the next space, and so on. Nothing happens if that space has no plane.
To land, every plane must be gone.

landingGear.title: Landing gear (pilot only)
landingGear.body:
Place a die that matches the space (1-2, 3-4 or 5-6), in any order. The switch shows green and the blue Aerodynamics marker moves one space at once; it ends between 7 and 8 with all the gear down. Playing on a space already green has no effect.
Moving the blue marker forward changes your speed: a 5 that advanced the plane 1 space may now advance it 0.
To land, all the landing gear must be down.

flaps.title: Flaps (co-pilot only)
flaps.body:
Place a die that matches the space, in order from top to bottom: 1-2, then 2-3, then 4-5, then 5-6. The switch shows green and the orange Aerodynamics marker moves one space at once; it ends just past 12 with all the flaps out.
To land, all the flaps must be deployed.

concentration.title: Concentration and coffee
concentration.body:
Either player may place any die here: take one Coffee token at once (at most 3).
Whenever you place a die, you may spend coffee: each token adds 1 to or subtracts 1 from that die. Anyone may spend any token, and unspent ones stay for later rounds. A die stays between 1 and 6: a 1 does not become a 6, nor a 6 a 1.

brakes.title: Brakes (pilot only)
brakes.body: Deploy the brakes in order: a 2, then a 4, then a 6. Each one moves the red Brake marker one space at once. Brakes only matter in the final round: your speed must then be lower than the Brake marker. You don't have to deploy them all, but the more you do, the easier the landing.

endOfRound.title: End of round
endOfRound.body:
Once all 8 dice are placed, you may talk again. The altitude track goes down one space (1000 ft) and you take your dice back.
Airport on the approach but not yet on the ground: you are in a holding pattern; play more rounds without advancing, so slow down!
On the ground but not at the airport: you crash before the runway and lose.

finalRound.title: The final round
finalRound.body:
It begins when the airport is in your Current Position and the plane is at the bottom of the altitude track.
Watch out: when the second Engine die is placed, compare your speed with the Brake marker instead of the Aerodynamics markers. The brakes don't all have to be out, but with no brake at all the plane cannot stop.

landing.title: Landing
landing.body:
At the end of the final round, you win if:
- no planes are left on the approach track,
- all the landing gear and flaps switches show green,
- the axis is level,
- your speed is lower than the Brake marker.
The passengers burst into applause!
